notes:
v1.5.0 - GUI polish + 6 new rule mods
GUI: Home screen redesigned into grouped panels (Game Setup / Avatars / Tools); lobby split into Players / Rule Mods / Host Settings; cleaner cards, buttons and market layouts. Update check page now shows the full changelog of the new version.
New rule mods (in-game Mods page, host-enforced): Bribe Economics, Night Market Timer, Trade Caravans, Guild Contracts, Royal Favor, Merchant Reputation.
Mod compatibility: conflicting rule mods are blocked at game start with a clear warning.
Bots: 4 personalities (Paranoid / Greedy / Honest / Reckless) so same-difficulty bots are distinguishable.
